implementationGuidance.scope: Eligible FHA forward Mutual Mortgage Insurance mortgage; verify program scope, historical dates and vintage rates separately. No automatic historical rate invention.
implementationGuidance.eligibility: Closing on/after2001-01-01 AND case number assigned before2013-06-03. Closing date alone does not classify modern vs historical.
implementationGuidance.longTerm: Original term>180months: historical78% threshold and at least60months paid MIP. Applies even if origination LTV below78%.
implementationGuidance.shortTerm: Term<=180: before2008-07-14 annual MIP at origination LTV>=90%; from2008-07-14 through2011-04-17 only if>90%; from2011-04-18 through2013-06-02 only if>78%. Otherwise no annualMIP. No five-year minimum for charged short-term branch.
implementationGuidance.originalValue: min(original sale price, original appraisal). No new appraisal appreciation.
implementationGuidance.normalization: Use noteToBaseFactor=(basePrincipal+actualFinancedUpfrontPremium)/basePrincipal. Equivalent base balance=noteBalance/factor; threshold=.78*originalValue. Equivalent note threshold=.78*originalValue*factor. This is a mathematical inference validated by the official1% screenshot anchor, not an explicit handbook equation.
implementationGuidance.criticalAntiBug: Do not subtract the original entire financed premium from every subsequent balance, and do not compare raw financed note balance directly with .78*originalValue. Use actual financed share; cash-paid UFMIP meansfactor1.
implementationGuidance.paymentTiming: Normal automatic projection uses original amortization, independent of extra principal. Actual prepayment crossing creates request eligibility only, with seasoning and payment-history checks; servicer supplies actual amortization to HUD and processes cancellation. A threshold date alone is not confirmation billing stopped.
implementationGuidance.premiumTiming: Keep threshold crossing month separate from verified final chargeable MIP month. Existing manual final-month path remains appropriate for billed-date/servicing precision. Do not claim civil14-day scheduling from26equalannual-period comparisons.
implementationGuidance.modernLoans: Case assigned on/after2013-06-03 uses applicable11-year/life-term policy, not78% prepayment cancellation.
